examples.japanese: テレビ{局|きょく}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a TV station.

examples.japanese: {郵便|ゆうびん}{局|きょく}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go to the post office.

notes:
{局|きょく} refers to offices or stations.

COMMON USES:
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{局|きょく} (post office)
- テレビ{局|きょく} (TV station)
- ラジオ{局|きょく} (radio station)
- {放送|ほうそう}{局|きょく} (broadcasting station)

GOVERNMENT OFFICES:
- {税務|ぜいむ}{局|きょく} (tax office)
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{局|きょく} (immigration bureau)
- {気象|きしょう}{局|きょく} (meteorological agency)

OTHER MEANINGS:
- {薬局|やっきょく} (pharmacy)
- {結局|けっきょく} (after all, in the end)
